title: Person
description: A profile page for someone who authored or proposed a ballot measure (a state legislator, a county or city official, a school or special district official, or a citizen initiative proponent) or who is a candidate in a tracked race. Referenced from a measure's authors[].person_id or a race's candidates[].person_id. scripts/validate.mjs validates against this file, so adding or changing a field means editing this file only.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier, also the output filename and the value authors[].person_id links to. Example: buffy-wicks.

type.description: What kind of public role this person holds. Use candidate for someone running for office who holds no current public office.

title.description: Current official title or role, e.g. "California State Assemblymember".

district.description: District or seat represented, e.g. "California State Assembly District 14". Omit if not applicable (e.g. an initiative proponent with no elected seat).

years_of_service.description: Tenure in the role, e.g. "2018–present" or "2016–2022". Omit if not applicable.

background.description: Biographical paragraphs: career, how they came to this office, notable prior work. One string per paragraph.

committee_memberships.description: Legislative or governing-body committees this person sits on. Omit or leave empty if not applicable.

voting_record_highlights.description: Specific, citable past votes worth knowing — not a general characterization. Each entry should be a concrete claim (bill/measure, how they voted, what it did).

attendance.description: Floor/meeting attendance or voting-participation record, if published by the body they serve on. Say so plainly if no such record is publicly available rather than omitting the field with no explanation.

endorsements_received.description: Who has endorsed this person (for their office, not for a specific measure). Empty array if none found.

past_measures_authored.description: Prior bills, propositions, or initiatives this person authored or sponsored, each with a verifiable outcome. Empty array if none found.

outcome.description: What happened to it, e.g. "Signed into law", "Approved by voters 62%–38%", "Failed to qualify", "Vetoed".

sources.description: Primary sources this profile rests on: official legislator/official bio page, vote-tracking sites (e.g. legislature.ca.gov, Ballotpedia), campaign finance disclosures.

last_updated.description: Date this file was last edited by a human, as YYYY-MM-DD.
